item.title: Instagram leads digital ad impressions with 64% share in Jan-Sep 2025: TAM AdEx
item.description: New Delhi: On publisher distribution, Instagram led web publishers in Jan-Sep '25 with a 64% share of ad impressions, while other publishers together accounted for 36%. Facebook.com followed with a 14% share, YouTube.com had an 8% share, and X.com had a 5% share. Amarujala.com, Cricbuzz.com, Indianexpress.com, Moneycontrol.com, Abplive.com, News18.com and Lokmat.com recorded 0.2% share each. item.title: Unicommerce names Gaurav Juneja as Chief Revenue Officer
item.description: New Delhi: Unicommerce has appointed Gaurav Juneja as its chief revenue officer, the company said on Wednesday. In his new role, Juneja will oversee Unicommerce’s revenue generation strategy, including sales and business development operations, customer engagement and market expansion. He will also be involved in shaping go-to-market strategies across newer business verticals such as B2B commerce, quick commerce and international markets. item.title: Patanjali sues YouTube channel over alleged defamatory video on Nutrela Soya Chunks
item.description: New Delhi: Patanjali Foods has moved the Bombay High Court against the YouTube channel ‘Trustified Certification’, alleging that a video uploaded on the channel defames and falsely maligns its product, Nutrela Soya Chunks. The company has sought Rs 15.5 crore in damages and an immediate injunction to remove the video from the platform. item.description: New Delhi: Bharti Airtel on Thursday said Shashwat Sharma, currently Chief Executive Officer designate, will assume charge as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the company with effect from January 1, 2026. item.description: New Delhi: Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in India’s 64 million Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises could unlock over USD 500 billion in economic value, but the country must move from an “adopt-first” to an “invent-first” mindset to realise the full opportunity, a new report said. item.title: Sony MAX lines up 10 sponsors for Saiyaara world TV premiere on Dec 20
item.description: New Delhi: Sony MAX has unveiled a multi-brand sponsor lineup for the world TV premiere of Saiyaara, scheduled to air on December 20, Saturday, at 8 pm. Pond’s Skin Institute, Dish TV’s smart TV brand VZY and Harley-Davidson X440T have come on board as co-presenters. UltraTech Cement, Google Search and Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk are listed as co-powered partners.
